description: This file defines the ParserException class within the SCSS PHP compiler library, representing exceptions thrown during parsing errors.

classes.name: ParserException
classes.description: An exception class for handling parsing errors in the SCSS PHP compiler, including source position information.

methods.name: getSourcePosition
methods.description: Retrieves the source position information where the parsing exception occurred.

methods.name: setSourcePosition
methods.description: Sets the source position information related to where the parsing error occurred.
